build:
Public Function Build() As String
Dim wb As Object, f As Object, r As Long
Application.DisplayAlerts = False
{layouts}
Build = "ok"
End Function
layout:
Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
wb.Worksheets(1).Name = "one"
wb.Worksheets.Add(After:=wb.Worksheets(1)).Name = "two"
wb.Worksheets("one").Activate
For r = 1 To 6
    wb.Worksheets("one").Cells(r, 1).Value = 9
    wb.Worksheets("one").Cells(r, 2).Value = 9
    wb.Worksheets("one").Cells(r, 3).Value = 9
    wb.Worksheets("two").Cells(r, 1).Value = 9
Next
{steps}{saves}wb.SaveAs "{folder}\{name}.xlsx", 51
wb.Close False

layouts.name: deleted
layouts.steps:
Set f = wb.Worksheets("one").Range("A1:A3").FormatConditions.Add(xlCellValue, xlGreater, "5")
f.Interior.Color = RGB(255, 0, 0)
Set f = wb.Worksheets("one").Range("B1:B3").FormatConditions.Add(xlCellValue, xlGreater, "5")
f.Interior.Color = RGB(0, 255, 0)
wb.Worksheets("one").Range("A1:A3").FormatConditions(1).Delete
